description: Read the configured server model catalogue. Returns immediately with job_id and status queued; work runs on the plugin worker.
embedding_description: Queue the configured OpenAI-compatible server model catalogue request. Returns job_id and status queued; job.result carries the original response with embedding-model entries and the configured default. Retrieve service_interface::job_service::get_job until terminal; failures also retain job.error.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Queued job handle with job_id and status; the final response is stored in job.result.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Retain this exact job_id. Schedule job_service::get_job while queued or processing; inspect terminal result or error before using the final data. Do not repeat a write because a poll is delayed.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Lists available embedding models from the OpenAI-compatible API
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: ConnectionError: API endpoint not reachable. APIError: Backend service doesn't support model listing.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For connection errors: verify the embedding service is running. If model listing is not supported, the configured default model will still be returned.
